nodes.title: The Poisoned Goblet
nodes.description: Found in Lord Neverember's bedchamber. Smells faintly of bitter almonds (Cyanide).

nodes.title: Silas the Butler
nodes.description: Purchased bitter almond extract from the apothecary two days before the feast. Fleed into the sewers.

nodes.title: The Zhentarim Sigil
